errors.text: The hypothesis upgrades lattice disorder into a specific HCP-mediated amorphization sequence, including complete amorphization at 1200 K, without evidence from the target.
It states that dislocation density is maintained or increases at 600 K, whereas the target attributes the modulus increase at 600 K to reduced dislocation density.
The proposed experiment lacks a thermal-only, unindented control and therefore cannot cleanly distinguish thermally induced disorder from mechanically induced annealing or defect annihilation.
